tips.text: Research Ogris first, then the Grattler at the Chem Lab; the 3 day timer runs before you can replicate the blueprint.
Level it on Steel Path Salacia with an affinity booster; it is the most repeated Archwing levelling node.
With a Gravimag installed, bring it out with the Archgun Deployer on a Spy mission so all weapon affinity lands on it.
Equip it on a Necramech in Lua Conjunction Survival to level it fast.
Expect the Tellurium to be the only grind; with Steel Path Ophelia and a booster the 5 take one run.
